From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Subject: Pipeline redistribution & dead-opportunity curation — action items and updated commits

Team —

Quick ask as we close Q2: finance ran the updated coverage model and we’re ~18% short to target if we carry current commit rates. I want a rapid hygiene pass and redistribution so our committed coverage reflects achievable outcomes. Please do the following by EOD PDT: 

- Use the attached "opportunity-cleanup-template.xlsx" and mark each opp as: Commit / Commit w/ Conditions / At Risk / Investigate / Stale (prune).
- For any opp you mark Stale, note owner recommendation (transfer or close) and reason (no response, legal, pricing).
- Propose redistribution for 2-3 at-risk deals you can reasonably accelerate (expected close & incremental $).
- Update HubSpot deals linked below and add a 1-line justification on the timeline change.

I'll consolidate and run a short redistribution meeting Monday at 9:00 AM PT to confirm owner reassignments and adjusted commit totals. We need to lift committed coverage to at least 85% of quota for the quarter to avoid runway risk.

Attachments: opportunity-cleanup-template.xlsx, redistribution-playbook.pdf

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Sr. Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

- HubSpot links updated for each opportunity. See note column for rationale.

I'll bring a short list of 6 prioritized accounts to Monday's call. Attaching my cleaned sheet (see attachment reference).

- I can take the Nimbus pilot upsell and ST-Cloud (per Marissa's suggestion). I've already exchanged discovery notes with Nimbus; I will push for a revised PO timeline.
- Two opps I flagged as Stale are worth a final outreach before pruning: 
  * ACME Health — last contact Jan 2027, legal review stalled; I'm happy to send the close-out email and offer a re-engagement slot.
  * CloudEdge — primary contact changed companies; propose transfer to Rishi for a warm intro to the new buyer.
- I'll update HubSpot and move the ownership as needed. Expect to add +$400k to committed coverage if both Nimbus and ST-Cloud convert in June.

Good updates — solid work. A couple of operational asks before Monday: 

- For any opp you mark Stale and plan to close, please paste the exact email you will send in the HubSpot note (we need auditability for finance).
- Marcus: if Nimbus procurement requests 60-day terms, escalate to me and include the SOW & cost rundown in the thread. Finance approval required for extended terms; I'll fast-track review if you include the expected IFR (impact to forecast) and collections plan.
- Soojin: can you consolidate all updated commit numbers into the one spreadsheet you send prior to the 9 AM meeting? We need a single coverage table to present to Finance.

I'll be available for the 9AM call. If anything material changes before then (signed PO or formal close), ping me immediately.

- Rishi
